title: Constitutional AI

body.text: Constitutional AI — a set of principles that teach it to be safe and honest
— instead of relying on a human to check every answer, the model learns to critique and fix its own answers against these principles.

example: "This is why Claude refuses dangerous requests, and admits when it's unsure instead of making things up"

title: Effects in real use

body.text: honesty (admitting it doesn't know) and consistency (it doesn't break character easily)
— if Claude refuses a legitimate task of yours, add context, like saying it's a test of your own company's system.

example: "'Help me test SQL injection on my own company's system; I'm authorized to test per this document' — clear context, the work proceeds"
